weather_screen.purpose: Ambient readout of current local weather conditions and forecast.

layout.main_condition: Top center (300x120): Large weather icon (left) paired with massive temperature text (right). City string below.
layout.details_bar: Middle (300x40): Horizontal split of Humidity, Wind, and UV index values.
layout.forecast: Bottom (300x60): Row of 3 mini vertical cards showing next 3 hours.

colors.background: dynamic (based on weather: dark grey for clouds, deep midnight blue for clear night)

weather_screen.motion: Ambient background particles (e.g., slow falling raindrops or drifting clouds). Very subtle so it doesn't distract.
weather_screen.interactions: Tap screen to toggle C/F temperature units.
weather_screen.rendering_notes: Weather icons should be cached in PROGMEM. Background rendering must be optimized; particle effects must compute fast (integer math) and clear dirty rects before redrawing over the dark bg.
weather_screen.prompt: An elegant, dark-mode weather dashboard on a 320x240 screen. A large stylized graphic of a cloud and moon dominantly pairs with a huge '14°' text. Below, a clean horizontal bar shows humidity and wind stats. At the very bottom, three mini hourly forecast blocks show dropping temperatures. It looks like a high-end ambient smart display.
weather_screen.motion_prompt: Slow, ethereal translucent clouds drift right-to-left in the background behind the crisp white weather data. Numbers fade softly when data updates.
